title: Pueblos indígenas
goal: Read about Latin America's more than forty million Indigenous people across hundreds of distinct peoples and languages, and the near-total lack of official recognition most states gave them for most of the twentieth century.

items: State roughly how many Indigenous people live in Latin America.
Name several major Indigenous peoples and where they live.
Explain how most states treated this diversity historically.
State when this situation began to change.
Use ni mucho menos to reinforce a negation.
